rows.quote: MATERIALS AND METHODS: Discovery MR utilized protein quantitative trait loci (pQTL) data on 4907 plasma protein levels from 35,559 individuals, alongside genome-wide association study (GWAS) on MASLD from the Million Veteran Program (68,725 cases / 95,482 controls).
rows.coder_note: The sentence names the outcome dataset as the MASLD GWAS from the Million Veteran Program (68,725 cases / 95,482 controls); the dictionary has no Million Veteran Program GWAS row (its only row with MVP is the FinnGen R12 + MVP + UK Biobank meta-analysis, which the sentence does not describe).
Only 'pQTL data for 2923 proteins from the UK Biobank'; the protein count is shared by several UK Biobank Olink rows and no sample size, release or citation is given (platform alone).
